name: Estuary
description: Three rings nested inside one another, each drawn a little off the last.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { width: 88%; height: 88%; margin: 6%; border-radius: 50%; border: calc(30px / @size-row) solid @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); box-sizing: border-box; :before { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 68%; height: 68%; left: @rand(4%, 26%); top: @rand(4%, 26%); border-radius: 50%; border: calc(30px / @size-row) solid @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 38%; height: 38%; left: @rand(18%, 42%); top: @rand(18%, 42%); border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
